LanguageData.RHAH_RefugeeMassacre.questDescriptionRul: questDescription->[sponsorName] says a ratkin camp of wooden huts nearby may threaten their settlement. They want every resident dead within 15 days. Finishing it pays 12 goodwill.\n\nThe camp holds 2 to 4 adults and 8 to 16 ratkin young under 8. There are no turrets and no power. Downing or capturing them does not finish it.
